newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 35 as Panamaxes remain strong.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 35 as Panamaxes remain strong.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose 35 points on Wednesday to 1,393 with Panamaxes still setting a very strong pace in nearly all areas except South America.

Broekrs said Drey fus fixed Rialto 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for end -November at $24.25 no combo, marginally up from last week's fixture of Banya at $24.10, and 50,000 heavy grain USGulf to China was reported fixed for November at $26.50, up $1 from rates reported on Tuesday.

Timecharter rates were very strong from USGulf with most modern vessels now asking in the region of $15,000 daily for trips to Far East and in the Pacific rates were climbing towards $13,000 daily for Australia rounds.
Capers were generally a bit firmer but rates for Handysizes continued to languish, brokers said.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was up to 13 points higher in the more active nearer positions and turnover reached 272 lots.
